3.name: Psionic Power
3.notes: Gain Psionic Energy Dice and the abilities Psi-Bolstered Knack and Psychic Whispers.

3.name: Psychic Blades
3.notes: Manifest psychic blades to make weapon attacks; includes Bonus Action secondary blade attack.

9.name: Soul Blades
9.notes:
Homing Strikes: If you miss with a Psychic Blade attack, roll a Psionic Energy Die and add to the roll; expend only on hit.

Psychic Teleportation: Bonus Action; create and throw a blade, expend a Psionic Energy Die, teleport up to 10 × roll feet.

13.name: Psychic Veil
13.notes: Magic Action: Become Invisible for 1 hour until dismissed or broken by dealing damage or forcing a save. Reuse after Long Rest or by expending 1 Psionic Energy Die.

17.name: Rend Mind
17.notes: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with Psychic Blades, force a Wisdom save (DC 8 + Dex mod + PB). On failure, the target is Stunned for 1 minute. Save ends at end of turns. Reuse after Long Rest or by expending 3 Psionic Energy Dice.
